properties.DESCRIPTION:
Brings you exclusive properties.
Life in farmhouses can be a unique and rewarding experience, offering a connection to nature, self-Sufficiency, and a simpler way of life. Farmhouses are typically situated in rural areas, surrounded by fievatika farm b-501, gorwal properties & developers, sohna, gurgaon, haryana
The vatika westin farmhouse , forests, and farm animals. These farmhouses are usually larger than typical homes and often have a history and character that adds to their charm.
One of the most significant benefits of living in a farmhouse is the opportunity to produce your own food. This farmhouse have large gardens and fields where you can grow fruits, vegetables, and herbs. Some even have livestock such as chickens, cows, or goats, which can provide fresh eggs, milk, and meat. Living in a farmhouse allows you to live off the land, and many people fincithis lifestyle to be fulfilling and rewarding.
Life in a farmhouse can also be very peaceful and quiet, away from the hustle and bustle of city life. You can enjoy the sounds of nature, such as birds chirping, cows mooing or the rustling of the wind through the trees. There is also usually plenty of space for outdoor activities like hiking, fishing, and hunting. Many people find that living in a farmhouse is a great way to recharge their batteries and escape the stresses of modern life.
Overall, life in a farmhouse can be a rewarding and fulfilling experience. It offers a unique opportunity to live off the land, connect with nature, and enjoy a simpler way of life.
However, it also requires hard work, dedication, and a willingness to embrace a more rustic lifestyle.

properties.DESCRIPTION:
Farmhouse for sale - 45 minutes from gurgaon 
Location: Intersection of sohna-Rewari road (Nh-919) & western peripheral (Kmp) expressway
Strategic investment highlights
Connectivity hub: Positioned at a critical multi-Modal intersection. The haryana orbital rail corridor (Horc)a 121.7 km double-Line projectruns adjacent to the property.
Proximity to rail stations: The farm is near proposed horc stations at sohna and dhulawat, which will connect directly to the delhi-Rewari line and major logistics hubs.
Industrial growth: Located near the imt sohna (1,500+ acres) development, which includes an electronics manufacturing cluster and major anchor units like atl battery technology.
Future "panchgram" city: The haryana government is developing five new planned cities along the kmp expressway; Suramya falls within this high-Growth "panchgram" region.
The "sweet water" edge: A rare operational borewell with 300 tds sweet water, providing a significant operational advantage in a region known for high salinity previous turns. 
Nearby heritage & leisure attractions
Position suramya as a base for exploring the rich indo-Islamic and natural heritage of the aravallis:
Sohna hill fort (17th century): Perched on the aravallis, offering panoramic views and a popular spot for photography and short treks.
Shri shiv kund: Famous natural sulfur hot springs and an ancient shiva temple, a key spiritual and wellness destination in sohna.
Heritage sites in nuh: Short drive to sheikh musa dargah (Known for its "shaking minarets"), chui mal ka talaab, and the historic kotla fort.
Damdama lake: A hub for adventure activities like boating, kayaking, and rock climbing, located just 10 km away. 
Property specs
Area: 2,000 square yards (3-Side open land).
Built-Up: Minimalist 2 bhk with all modern comforts, ready for immediate use or farm-Stay rental

Life in farmhouses can be a unique and rewarding experience, offering a connection to nature, self-Sufficiency, and a simpler way of life. Farmhouses are typically situated in rural areas, surrounded by fievatika farm b-501, gorwal properties & developers, sohna, gurgaon, haryana
Skrealtech grouplds, forests, and farm animals. These farmhouses are usually larger than typical homes and often have a history and character that adds to their charm.
One of the most significant benefits of living in a farmhouse is the opportunity to produce your own food. This farmhouse have large gardens and fields where you can grow fruits, vegetables, and herbs. Some even have livestock such as chickens, cows, or goats, which can provide fresh eggs, milk, and meat. Living in a farmhouse allows you to live off the land, and many people fincithis lifestyle to be fulfilling and rewarding.
Life in a farmhouse can also be very peaceful and quiet, away from the hustle and bustle of city life. You can enjoy the sounds of nature, such as birds chirping, cows mooing or the rustling of the wind through the trees. There is also usually plenty of space for outdoor activities like hiking, fishing, and hunting. Many people find that living in a farmhouse is a great way to recharge their batteries and escape the stresses of modern life.
Overall, life in a farmhouse can be a rewarding and fulfilling experience. It offers a unique opportunity to live off the land, connect with nature, and enjoy a simpler way of life.
However, it also requires hard work, dedication, and a willingness to embrace a more rustic lifestyle.
